visual_quality_notes.walls: PVGames wall panels and door art imply rooftop garage/greenhouse structure.

visual_quality_notes.entry_care: Door, care cabinet, crates, boxes, and label mark the entry/Bentley care corner.
visual_quality_notes.cozy_lounge: Bed, couch, chairs, mat, barrel side table, and warm glow create a soft southwest lounge.
visual_quality_notes.mission_board: Screen bank, sign, wall backer, and cyan glow mark mission selection.
visual_quality_notes.big_case: Evidence screen, wall backer, warm light, and label mark mystery/progression.
visual_quality_notes.planning_table: Table, chairs, monitor, and mat reinforce scheme-card planning.
visual_quality_notes.collectibles: Shelves/cabinet/billboard accents make west displays readable.
